title: Boston Public Schools
scope: This ledger ranks every DESE-listed Boston Public Schools school (district 00350000) on 2025-26 enrollment, reports district enrollment by gender, race, grade, and selected populations, DESE FY 2025 total expenditures per pupil and the published spending categories, teacher FTE and average salary from the same finance file, and the last exact published daily-bus and morning-run counts from the April 2025 BPS Transportation progress report.
exclusions: Does not cover charter or Horace Mann districts that are not 00350000, waitlists, lottery outcomes, statewide Massachusetts enrollment or MCAS (those sit on Massachusetts Schools), City of Boston payroll or the BPS budget line on Boston City Payroll, other cities, or advice about a school. BPS does not publish a machine-readable route roster; later School Committee memos that say daily buses were fewer than 625 do not replace the last exact published count.
heritage: New. The Tableau suite did not publish a Boston Public Schools district namesake.
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 19, 2026 from DESE / E2C t8td-gens for district 00350000, school year 2025-26 (sy=2026). District enrollment 44,416 matches the DESE profile. 105 school rows sum to that total. Gender counts 21,165 / 23,214 / 37 match the DESE Enrollment by Gender table and the E2C percentages to one decimal. FY 2025 total expenditures per pupil $34,833 is E2C er3w-dyti. Daily buses 640 are the last exact count printed in BPS Driving Change, April 2025 (SRC-634-03).

q: Enrollment, gender, per-pupil spending, and bus routes for Boston Public Schools.
lead: Boston Public Schools enrolled 44,416 students in 105 DESE-listed schools in 2025-26 (SRC-634-01). 23,214 were male and 21,165 were female (SRC-634-01). Total expenditures per pupil were $34,833 in FY 2025 (SRC-634-02). The April 2025 transportation report printed 640 buses on the road (SRC-634-03).
